answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation, in its SEC Form 8-K current report dated August 17, 2026 (Items 1.01 and 2.03).
answer.note: NVIDIA reported that on August 17, 2026 it entered multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy for leases covering approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site, where OpenAI is the tenant and is expected to deploy NVIDIA’s DSX AI factory platform. NVIDIA says it secured land, power, and shell capacity there for its AI compute infrastructure. The guarantees’ aggregate payment obligation for the initial commitment is capped at $105 billion; an agreement generally becomes effective when its applicable lease commences, and payments are conditional, including on ready-for-service conditions expected to begin in 2028 and an OpenAI insolvency-related lease default or failure to pay. A payment generally covers a shortfall between the guaranteed minimum lease value and proceeds from reletting or sale. NVIDIA may, at its discretion, provide credit support for approximately 3.8 GW of additional capacity. OpenAI has agreed to reimburse and indemnify NVIDIA for amounts it actually pays. This is evidence of a substantial, contingent NVIDIA financial exposure tied to infrastructure capacity and a named tenant, not evidence of an immediate payment, a $105 billion expected loss, or NVIDIA sales or orders of a specified amount. The tenant and planned platform deployment support a potential demand connection for NVIDIA’s infrastructure, while the stated capacity and conditional timing do not establish realized deployment or demand.
limitations: The report says the form of the agreements will be filed with NVIDIA’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026; the full terms, including lease-specific guaranteed values and detailed conditions, are therefore not available in this report.
The report does not state when each applicable lease will commence, the likelihood or amount of any trigger-related payment, or whether NVIDIA has made a payment or recovered amounts from OpenAI.
follow_up: Review the referenced Form 10-Q exhibit for the agreement terms, including lease-specific values, conditions, and termination provisions.
Track disclosures on lease commencement, ready-for-service status, OpenAI payment or insolvency events, and any guarantee payments, recoveries, or indemnity reimbursements.
Check NVIDIA’s next annual filing for whether it reports any payment under these guaranties.

proposal.question: Will NVIDIA report any payment under the SB Energy residual value guaranties by its next annual filing?
proposal.settled_by: NVIDIA’s next annual filing after August 17, 2026, checked for disclosure of payments made under these guaranties.
proposal.time_scope: Through NVIDIA’s next annual filing after August 17, 2026.
proposal.lost_if_folded: A separate check of whether the already-entered guaranties produce an actual payment, rather than treating the disclosed contingent exposure and the broader Portsmouth capacity partnership as the same outcome.
